name: Clean-up icon follows focus and clears the "Назва" field
description:
Admins can create team member categories
  and get validation feedback while filling in the category form.
descriptionHtml:
Admins can create team member categories
and get validation feedback while filling in the category form.

testStage.description:
Admins can create team member categories
  and get validation feedback while filling in the category form.

steps.name: Given the admin is logged in
And the admin opens the Team page
And the admin opens the Add category modal
Open Team category context menu
Open the add Team category dialog
When the admin clicks inside the "Назва" field
Click inside the 'Назва' field
Then the clean-up icon is not displayed in the "Назва" field
Check clean-up icon is hidden in the 'Назва' field
When the admin enters "Volunteers" into the "Назва" field
Enter Team category name: Volunteers
Then the clean-up icon is displayed in the "Назва" field
Check clean-up icon is shown in the 'Назва' field
When the admin clicks outside the field
Leave the 'Назва' field
Then the clean-up icon is not displayed in the "Назва" field
Check clean-up icon is hidden in the 'Назва' field
When the admin clicks inside the "Назва" field
Click inside the 'Назва' field
Then the clean-up icon is displayed in the "Назва" field
Check clean-up icon is shown in the 'Назва' field
When the admin clicks the clean-up icon in the "Назва" field
Click the clean-up icon in the 'Назва' field
Then the "Назва" field is empty
And the "Назва" character counter shows "0/20"
